2) Do you want to move only the single occurrence (the next Thursday at 3:00 PM) or the whole recurring series? Reply "one" or "series".  
3) Confirm you want Friday 10:00–10:45 AM, timezone Europe/London, attendees: you, Kiran, Dana.

If all correct, reply "Yes — reschedule" and I'll reschedule it.
